title: Disposable Filters per Month From Compliance Data — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** For a coverage-billed disposable-filter (A7038) line of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the filters per month are worked out from the compliance downloads on the patient's PAP device record held under PAP Therapy Equipment:

1. when the newest compliance download that met the device class's compliance standard was taken within the last 6 months and shows an average daily use of 5.0 hours or more, the filters per month are the schedule's monthly filter allowance: **two a month**, or **four a month on the Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule**;
2. when a compliance download was taken within the last 6 months but the condition of line 1 is not met, the filters per month are scaled to measured use: the allowance multiplied by the newest download's average daily use and divided by 8 hours, rounded up to a whole filter, and never more than the allowance.

Where no compliance download was taken within the last 6 months, no device-data rate applies.

## Terms

- **Within the last 6 months:** the download was taken fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the handling day.
- **Met the compliance standard:** the download is recorded on the device record as having met the device class's compliance standard.
- **The newest download** in line 2 is the newest compliance download of any result, which need not be the download that met the standard.

## Input — judgement — output

| Newest download that met the standard: taken within 6 months and averaging 5.0 hours or more | Any download taken within 6 months | Filters per month |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the allowance (2, or 4 on Commercial PPO) |
| no | yes | allowance multiplied by the newest download's average hours, divided by 8, rounded up, capped at the allowance |
| no | no | no device-data rate |

## Worked examples (hypothetical downloads)

- Commercial HMO patient; newest download that met the standard taken 2 months ago, averaging 6.1 hours: 2 filters a month.
- Commercial HMO patient; newest download taken 1 month ago averages 3.2 hours and the last download that met the standard averaged 4.7 hours: line 2 applies. 2 multiplied by 3.2 is 6.4; divided by 8 is 0.8; rounded up, 1 filter a month.
- Commercial PPO patient, same downloads: 4 multiplied by 3.2 is 12.8; divided by 8 is 1.6; rounded up, 2 filters a month.
- A newest download averaging 9.0 hours under line 2 on a two-a-month schedule: 2 multiplied by 9.0, divided by 8, is 2.25, rounded up to 3, but never more than the allowance, so 2.
